entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand Cadence Sensor is broken. I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
Alex Chen, order 774-B2. Look, I don't have a lot of time. Is it returnable or not?
I understand you're busy, Alex. I've pulled up your account. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The thing is completely defective. It's not working at all. It won't sync with my app, and when it does connect for a second, the numbers are just nonsense. It's broken.
I see. I'm very sorry for the frustration that's caused. One moment while I check the return eligibility based on your delivery date.
Just tell me yes or no.

Yes, absolutely. I see here that your item was delivered 26 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. Since you're reporting it as defective, I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Okay, good. Finally. What do you need from me?

I've just processed the return authorization. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. And Alex, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience of receiving a defective unit, I've also added a $50 credit to your account.
Got the email. The credit is fine. Thanks.
You're most welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
